title: How do I get started with OrbitThink?
desc: Simply book a free strategy call with us. We'll discuss your idea, analyze your needs, and propose a 'Mission Trajectory' for your project.

title: How does OrbitThink ensure data security?
desc: We build with security-first architectures, including HIPAA compliance for healthcare and secure encryption for fintech applications.

title: What is the process for requesting a consultation?
desc: You can reach out via our contact form or email us at contact@orbitthink.com. We'll schedule an initial 'Ignition' meeting.

title: Can you provide references or case studies?
desc: Absolutely. Check out our 'Mission Logs' (Portfolio) to see detailed case studies of our work in Gaming, AI, and Web Development.

title: What technologies do you use?
desc: We use a modern stack including Unity, Flutter, Next.js, React, Python (FastAPI), Azure, AWS, and various AI models.
